A container without an icon of its own shows the logo of the app it runs, and update windows wait for the download before they say done.

## ✨ Added
- **Logos for containers without an icon.** Where Unraid shows its question mark, the Docker tab shows the logo of the app the container runs, coloured in your icon style. TowerTorch knows the app by the container's image, and by its name only when the image gives nothing away. 70 logos ship with the plugin, so they show without internet too. Only the display changes, the container's template stays as it is, and the new App logos card on the Docker tab of the settings turns them off.
- **The icon search knows a container by its image.** A container with an icon of its own is looked up by the app its image runs as well, so one you gave a name of your own still finds its brand logo. An icon you set yourself is never swapped.

## 🎨 Design
- **The User Scripts list uses the whole width.** The list pinned every column to a fixed width and left most of a wide page empty. Names and descriptions get the room, the buttons stand in even columns from row to row, and in a narrow window they move below the name.

## 🐛 Fixed
- **Update windows wait for the download.** When you updated a container or a plugin, the progress window could show its tick and Done from the start, carried over from the window before it on the same page. Every window starts with the loading ring and shows the tick only once the job is finished.
- **The arrow on a script category's tile follows your icon style.** It stayed white and vanished on a light accent such as yellow. It takes the tile's ink, black on yellow.
- **A brand glyph no longer shows in plain black.** With Tint icons off, a known app's one-colour glyph could replace its logo and stay black. The logo stays in that case.
